lines.en: Just when things start to turn around, they fall apart.
Now I know exactly how FDR felt after Pearl Harbor.
Look, you guys have survived this long.
Please don't let this ruin your night.
Let's have fun. It's Halloween. You love Halloween.
Hey, I know it would cheer you up.
Let's go wait outside the bathroom for Tom and scare him.
Oh, God. Oh, I think he might be having a heart attack.
Oh, so much stuff is happening right now.
Just breathe, okay? You're gonna be fine.
Oh, jeez, did a dinosaur just fart?
I wish I could stop smelling.
Seriously, Jerry, did you eat farts for lunch?
Oh, no, I didn't know that.
Okay, I got you some magazines and those boring word jumbles you like to do.
Is there anything else you need, Jay?
He should be out of here in a day or two.
Doctor, medically speaking, how would you describe what happened to Jerry?
He had a mild heart attack.
Yeah, but he also exhibited excessive flatulence.
Is there a term for having a heart attack while releasing so much gas?
Gastrointestinal distress is common during a cardiac event.
I just want to hear the doctor say that Jerry had a fart attack.
Is that too much to ask?
Look at all the balloons and the flowers and the food.
And my goodness, you're so sweet to come visit this often.
I mean, yeah, I could do without the massive hospital bills, but no, this was a wake-up call.
I want at least another 30 years with Gail and my girls.
You are gonna have the future that you've always planned.
